title: Compress repeated readings
description: Bug report for a function that compresses a list of sensor readings into runs. Two symptoms: the last run of the list is sometimes missing from the result, and a long streak is split into runs that are one reading too long. Fix the program. The complete rule is: a limit below 1 is an error with the message "invalid limit"; otherwise consecutive equal readings are merged into one run, in order, each run holding the reading (value) and how many times it repeats in a row (count); a run never holds more than limit readings, so a longer streak continues in a new run of the same value; an empty list gives an empty list. For example, with a limit of 3 the readings 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 give the runs (1, 3), (1, 3), (1, 1).
notes: Two bugs: the final run is flushed only when its count is above 1 (so a final single reading vanishes); the split test is count <= limit, so runs reach limit + 1. Visible examples are chosen so that the start passes them (the adapters run visible examples in tool_check). Negative readings appear in the tests; no division anywhere.
